protocol.sampler: reuse B20 physical-window order; clean/background per physical window; no outcome-dependent resampling
protocol.scheduler: MultiStepLR milestones=[600], gamma=0.1, applied after each update; no reduced-LR update before final
protocol.backend: Math SDPA, Flash and memory-efficient disabled
protocol.action_loss: official unweighted mean L1 over all8x7 valid values
protocol.stage: joint action and auxiliary, no additional RLA-only updates
protocol.randomness: same initial CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy state and official stochastic graph for C/D; added RLA draws need not reproduce B20 random consumption after step0
protocol.selection: final600 only, no early stopping or budget extension
protocol.RLA_auxiliary_baseline: B has original official action head, no auxiliary supervision
protocol.memory: same non-reentrant activation checkpointing for B/C/D; expandable allocator, cache release
protocol.initialization: trained original C parameters; reinitialize only layer_norm2_rla and fc2_rla
protocol.keep_loss: masked mean L1(student(training appearance), frozen eval C(same-state clean)); beta0 or1
protocol.numerical_loss_coordinates: official normalized action space; valid 8x7 elements; float32 reduction for keep
protocol.teacher: train observations only; no future frames or sidecars; teacher outputs are not ground truth
